meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
When looking for a face wash for oily skin in India under ₹500, the best options focus on ingredients like **Salicylic Acid (BHA)**, **Niacinamide**, or **Green Tea** to help control excess oil, clear pores, and prevent breakouts without stripping your skin's natural moisture.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=Before%20you%20buy%20oily%20skin,oil%20production%20and%20soothes%20inflammation.)

Here are some of the top-rated, budget-friendly options widely available in India:

---

### Top Face Washes for Oily Skin Under ₹500

| Brand & Product | Key Ingredients | Estimated Price (INR) | Why It’s Great for Oily Skin |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Cleanser** | Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc | ~₹299 | Deeply penetrates pores to dissolve excess sebum and reduce pimples without being overly harsh. |
| **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** | Green Tea, Glycolic Acid | ~₹319 - ₹380 | Gently exfoliates dead skin cells, fights acne-causing bacteria, and leaves a refreshing, non-greasy feel. |
| **The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, Witch Hazel | ~₹299 | Targets active acne, tightens pores, and controls oil production effectively. |
| **Pilgrim Tea Tree Purifying Foaming Face Wash** | Tea Tree, Salicylic Acid | ~₹175 | Offers built-in foaming convenience with natural antibacterial tea tree oil to manage oiliness. |
| **Dot & Key Cica Calming Blemish Clearing Gel Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, Cica, Green Tea | ~₹214 - ₹249 | Great if your oily skin is also sensitive or prone to redness and irritation. |

---

### Quick Tips for Oily Skin

* **Look for Gel or Foaming Textures:** These formats work best to lift away excess oil and grime compared to thick, cream-based cleansers.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=Why%20a%20Foaming%20Cleanser%20is,trapped%20deep%20within%20your%20pores.)
* **Don't Over-Wash:** Cleansing twice a day (morning and night) is plenty.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=Q1%3A%20How%20often%20should%20I,cleanser%20make%20my%20skin%20dry%3F) Washing too frequently can trick your skin into producing even *more* oil to compensate for dryness.
* **Follow up with Moisture:** Even oily skin needs hydration.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=A%3A%20Yes%2C%20most%20over-,doesn't%20require%20expensive%20treatments.) Pair your cleanser with a lightweight, oil-free, or gel-based moisturizer to keep your skin barrier balanced.
